We use two metrics. (1) The Triplet Metric. For the experiments on CPL datasets, we use the traditional text-to-table metric consisting of precision, recall, and F1-score along with the overall error rate of the generated triplet. (2) The Counting Metric. For the experiments on LiveSum datasets and our Agent Counter on CPL, we predict the number of instances of each type in each sample and evaluate RMSE and error rate.
